{{Top|leg}}
'''Prism pebbles''' , also called '''Story pebbles''', were pebbles found on the Forest Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], which could be used to create illusions. Chief [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] borrowed some prism pebbles from [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], which he used to create illusions to tell the Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] the story of [[Morag]] and the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]] [[Shadowstone]]. Chirpa later returmed them to Logray in his hut, telling him that it was a great evening. [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesa]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], then came to the hut, and Teebo impressed them by using a pebble to create an illusion of a flying Endorian creature. They then asked to see more magic, and Teebo said they should go to the forest where it is safer to use magic. When they got there, he created an illusion of Logray with a pebble. He then tried to use a pebble to create music with a flute, but it caused the flute to spin wildly in the air which a bubble like blur formed around it, and it then fell to the ground, causing Teebo to trip and break Logray's wand. After rescuing the young Ewoks from Morag, Logray reprimanded Teebo for wasting his prism pebbles, ruining his wand, and almost getting them killed.<ref name="1-9">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref>

After, back at the village, Logray used the pebbles to tell the story of how the Sunstar Shadowstone returned to the village, creating illusions of the Sunstar Shadowstone  and a heart to represent Morag's lifeforce returning to the forest, eventually becoming a thing of beauty, before allowing Teebo to reach into his sack to use Prism pebbles, which Teebo uses to create firework illusions with firework sounds.<ref name="1-9"></ref>
